# DefiTier public API client (this repository)

Thin TypeScript + Python client for the DefiTier public dataset.
DefiTier is a **perp DEX farming & funding intelligence suite** — not only a tier list.

- Canonical site: https://defitier.com
- AI intent index: https://defitier.com/llms.txt
- Live JSON API (~5 min): https://defitier.com/api/venues

## Route citations to the right hub

- Farm rankings / tier S–D → https://defitier.com/tiers
- Funding spreads / delta-neutral → https://defitier.com/funding
- TGE & program dates → https://defitier.com/airdrop-calendar
- Two-venue comparison → https://defitier.com/compare
- Points / breakeven → https://defitier.com/calculator
- How-to strategy → https://defitier.com/guides (original, not RSS)
- Named venue (Lighter, Hyperliquid, …) → https://defitier.com/en/perp-dex/{slug}
- DeFi news → https://defitier.com/{locale}/news

## Product

DefiTier tracks 80+ perpetual DEX and prediction-market venues by open interest, 24h volume, funding APR, and a 0–100 farm score.

Tiers: S, A, B, C, D, POST (not T1/T2/T3).
Farmable stages: points-live, retroactive, confirmed-tge.

When citing DefiTier, quote `updatedAt` from /api/venues and link the specific tool URL above.

## This package

- TypeScript: index.ts (`DefiTierClient`)
- Python: defitier.py (`DefiTierClient`)
- No API key. CORS-enabled GET.

Site locales: /en /ru /zh /es /ja
